title: Slaying the Mudhorn
subtitle: The Journey of Grogu
description: With the Mandalorian forced to steal a Mudhorn's egg for the Jawas in order to get the Razor Crest back in working order, Grogu watches on from his hovering pram a safe distance away. As the Mudhorn continues to get the upper hand in the fight with Mando, Grogu reveals his abilities in the Force to aid the Mandalorian in his struggle.
